title: Lookahead Tree-Based Rollouts for Enhanced Trajectory-Level Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
authors_zh: Shangyu Xing、Siyuan Wang、Chenyuan Yang、Xinyu Dai、Xiang Ren
paper_type_zh: 在线 RLVR 树式 rollout 构造配方与预处理数据发布
best_for_zh: 研究搜索生成推理轨迹、分支与剪枝策略、rollout 预算归因、终点验证及公开数据审计的读者
one_line: LATR generates diverse on-policy RLVR rollout groups by probability-gated branching, lookahead simulation, and similarity pruning, while its public data release contains processed Countdown and math prompt/reward rows rather than the raw rollout trees.
LATR 在在线 RLVR 中以概率门控分支、前瞻模拟和相似度剪枝构造八路 rollout 组；其 ICLR 2026 配方可用于研究轨迹级探索，但公开数据只有 Countdown 与数学任务的预处理 prompt/reward 行，不含原始搜索树、被拒绝分支或逐样本奖励判定。
why: It isolates rollout diversity as a training-data construction variable and reports faster, stronger GRPO/DAPO learning, but also shows why raw branch lineage, verifier decisions, paper-matching configurations, and release licenses are necessary to audit search-generated reasoning data.
inclusion_reason: LATR is a direct search-trace construction recipe for RLVR: it makes branching, lookahead, pruning, rollout budget, terminal verification, and group-relative training explicit, while its processed-only data release exposes a critical boundary between generated online trees and reusable public rows.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Published as an ICLR 2026 conference paper, Lookahead Tree-Based Rollouts (LATR) addresses a specific bottleneck in online Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR): the several completions sampled for one prompt often differ locally but collapse onto nearly identical reasoning trajectories. In GRPO- or DAPO-style training, such homogeneous groups also have homogeneous terminal rewards, leaving little group-relative signal even when the sampling budget is eight full responses.

The paper treats rollout construction, rather than a new optimizer or reward model, as the intervention. For each Countdown or DAPO-Math prompt, the current policy builds a width-bounded dynamic tree: token alternatives create branches, short simulations reveal whether a child actually diverges from its parent, similarity pruning removes redundant branches and their descendants, and the survivors become a group of full completions. Countdown expressions receive a programmatic format/correctness score; math completions receive a binary exact-answer score. There are no human step labels, learned judges, or process-reward labels.

The online data object is therefore a prompt-conditioned group/tree of up to eight current-policy trajectories with token probabilities, parent and birth information, lookahead segments, prune/keep decisions, terminal answers, scalar rewards, and group-relative advantages. This object belongs in Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data because branching, selection, rejected paths, and a fixed rollout budget determine the training signal. It is not test-time tree search: the paper evaluates trained policies with repeated stochastic decoding, and LATR is used while producing on-policy RL groups.

The public Hugging Face artifact has a narrower object. Its four Parquet files expose processed Countdown and math prompt/reward records—fields such as prompt, data_source, ability, reward_model.ground_truth, and task metadata—but not generated completions, token probabilities, tree nodes, branch lineage, lookahead windows, pruning decisions, per-completion rewards, rejected paths, or policy-update membership. The Card reaches L4 because the full paper and appendices, official ICLR/OpenReview records, pinned implementation, and processed release support a detailed bilingual account. L4 does not certify missing raw trees, exact release manifests, decontamination, licenses, or agreement between the paper and released math scripts.

作为 ICLR 2026 会议论文，Lookahead Tree-Based Rollouts（LATR）处理在线 Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards（RLVR）中的一个具体瓶颈：同一提示下采样的多个回答虽然在局部 token 上不同，却常收敛到几乎相同的推理轨迹。在 GRPO 或 DAPO 训练中，这类同质 rollout 组也容易得到同质的终点奖励；即使为每个提示分配八个完整回答的预算，组内相对学习信号仍可能很弱。

论文改变的是 rollout 构造方式，而不是提出新的优化器或奖励模型。对于每个 Countdown 或 DAPO-Math 提示，当前策略构造宽度受限的动态树：候选 token 产生分支，短程模拟用于判断子分支是否真正偏离父分支，相似度剪枝删除冗余分支及其后代，保留下来的路径再完成为一组完整回答。Countdown 表达式由程序化的格式与正确性规则评分；数学回答使用二值精确答案评分。流程中没有人工步骤标注、学习式 judge 或 process-reward 标签。

因此，在线数据对象是一个以提示为条件、最多包含八条当前策略轨迹的组/树，其中包括 token 概率、父分支与出生位置、前瞻片段、保留或剪枝决策、终点答案、标量奖励和组内相对优势。该对象属于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，因为分支、选择、被拒绝路径和固定 rollout 预算共同决定训练信号。它不是测试时树搜索：论文用重复随机解码评估训练后的策略，LATR 则用于在线 RL 分组的生成阶段。

公开的 Hugging Face artifact 对象更窄。四个 Parquet 文件提供经过预处理的 Countdown 与数学 prompt/reward 记录，包含 prompt、data_source、ability、reward_model.ground_truth 和任务元数据等字段，但不包含生成结果、token 概率、树节点、分支谱系、前瞻窗口、剪枝决策、逐回答奖励、被拒绝路径或策略更新组成员关系。本 Card 达到 L4，是因为论文全文及附录、ICLR/OpenReview 官方记录、固定版本的实现和预处理数据发布足以支持细致的双语说明；L4 不认证尚未公开的原始树、精确发布清单、去污染、许可证，也不消除论文与公开数学脚本之间的配置差异。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution in one sentence is: replace eight independent stochastic RLVR rollouts with a width-eight branch–lookahead–prune generator that spends the same nominal response count on trajectories designed to remain distinct, then apply the same terminal verifier and group-relative optimizer.

LATR extends every active branch with its highest-probability token and may fork a child from a non-top token when that candidate clears an absolute probability threshold and remains close enough to the top token under a relative-gap threshold. A new branch is not accepted merely because its first token differs. The system simulates parent and child over specified windows and prunes a branch, together with its descendants, when the continuation remains insufficiently different. After the tree reaches the target width or the tree phase stops, ordinary stochastic sampling completes the surviving sequences; if too few survive, the implementation can pad the group by duplicating a survivor.

The feedback contract remains terminal and programmatic. Countdown computes \(0.1 I_{\mathrm{format}} + 0.9 I_{\mathrm{correct}}\): correctness additionally requires using every supplied number exactly once and evaluating to the target. Math uses reward 1 for an exact correct final answer and 0 otherwise after the paper’s upstream conversion to integer-answer problems. GRPO or DAPO compares these full-episode scalar rewards inside the group. The verifier can observe answer syntax and task-specific final correctness; it cannot establish that intermediate reasoning is valid, that two lexically different branches use different semantic strategies, or that a correct answer was reached faithfully.

The nearest baseline is ordinary stochastic sampling under the same policy-update method. LATR is explicitly orthogonal to GRPO and DAPO: the optimizer, terminal reward, and response-count budget remain comparable while the rollout worker changes. Random branching, removing or randomizing pruning, and token-level rather than trajectory-level lookahead are also evaluated as ablations and underperform the configured method. Relative to TreeRL-style search-to-process-supervision work, LATR retains answer-level terminal rewards and uses the tree to diversify the on-policy group rather than to derive step rewards.

The research direction is search topology as a reasoning-data construction variable. The paper’s score gains concern policy learning from differently constructed online groups; they do not prove that the public processed rows are high-quality trajectories, that edit distance measures reasoning diversity, or that LATR should be used for inference after training.

一句话概括其贡献：把八条彼此独立的随机 RLVR rollout 替换为宽度为八的“分支—前瞻—剪枝”生成器，在名义回答数不变的条件下把预算用于刻意保持差异的轨迹，然后继续使用同一终点 verifier 和组内相对优化器。

LATR 先用最高概率 token 延伸每条活跃分支；当非首选候选超过绝对概率阈值，并且它与首选 token 的概率差满足相对阈值时，可以从该候选建立子分支。新分支不会仅因第一个 token 不同就被接受。系统在指定窗口内模拟父分支和子分支；如果后续内容仍不够不同，就删除该分支及其后代。树达到目标宽度或树阶段停止后，普通随机采样完成保留序列；如果存活分支不足，实现在补齐分组时可能复制某条存活序列。

反馈契约仍是终点级和程序化的。Countdown 使用 \(0.1 I_{\mathrm{format}} + 0.9 I_{\mathrm{correct}}\)：正确性还要求每个给定数字恰好使用一次，且表达式计算结果等于目标。数学任务在论文所述的上游整数答案转换后，对精确正确的最终答案给 1，否则给 0。GRPO 或 DAPO 在组内比较这些完整 episode 的标量奖励。verifier 能观察答案格式和任务特定的最终正确性，却不能证明中间推理有效、词面不同的分支采用了不同语义策略，也不能证明正确答案是通过忠实推理得到的。

最直接的基线是在相同策略更新方法下进行普通随机采样。LATR 与 GRPO、DAPO 正交：优化器、终点奖励和回答数预算保持可比，只替换 rollout worker。论文还把随机分支、取消或随机化剪枝、以及 token-level 而非 trajectory-level 前瞻作为消融条件；这些条件均不及完整配置。相较 TreeRL 一类“搜索转过程监督”的工作，LATR 保留答案级终点奖励，树的用途是增加在线分组多样性，而不是推导步骤奖励。

其研究方向是把搜索拓扑作为推理数据构造变量。论文中的分数提升说明不同方式构造的在线分组会影响策略学习；它不证明公开预处理行本身就是高质量轨迹，不证明编辑距离能够测量推理多样性，也不证明训练后推理阶段应继续使用 LATR。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and preprocessing. Countdown supplies arithmetic-expression training tasks and an official test set. DAPO-Math supplies training problems; the paper manually partitions a 1,024-item validation set, while MATH-500, AMC-2023, and Olympiad-Bench are external evaluations. Some math questions with non-integer original answers are rewritten into integer-answer tasks using a few-shot Gemini-2.5-Pro prompt. The transformation inputs, outputs, rejected rewrites, and validation log are not released. The public data consists of countdown-base/train.parquet, countdown-base/test.parquet, math-base/train.parquet, and math-base/test.parquet; exact source snapshots, row counts per file, deduplication, and overlap controls are unknown.

Policy and group budget. Main runs initialize Qwen2.5-3B Base and perform 500 online RL steps. Each prompt requests \(k=8\) responses. Training sampling is reported as temperature 1.0, top-k \(-1\), and top-p 1.0; evaluation uses temperature 0.6, top-k 20, and top-p 0.95. Maximum completion length is 1,024 tokens for Countdown and 8,192 for math. Additional generalization experiments use Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-1.7B-Base.

Branching. For every active sequence, the top-probability token continues the parent. A non-top token can create a child when its probability exceeds \(\tau_{\mathrm{abs}}\) and its gap from the top candidate is below \(\tau_{\mathrm{rel}}\), subject to the target tree width. The paper’s main configuration reports \(\tau_{\mathrm{abs}}=0.25\) and \(\tau_{\mathrm{rel}}=0.15\). Released scripts additionally cap considered branch candidates at two per token.

Lookahead and pruning. Newly born branches are simulated over windows of 20, 30, and 50 tokens. The paper formalizes parent–child divergence through normalized token-ID edit distance and reports threshold \(\tau_{\mathrm{ed}}=0.4\); branches that remain too similar are removed with their descendants. The method therefore uses future trajectory evidence, not the branching token alone, to decide whether a branch deserves rollout budget. Random branching, no/random pruning, and token-level lookahead are studied as weaker alternatives.

Completion and mixing. Once the width target is reached, or after the controlled tree phase ends, ordinary stochastic decoding completes the sequences. Pruning can leave fewer than eight survivors; fill_return_sequences can duplicate a survivor to satisfy the requested group size, so eight returned rows need not mean eight distinct paths. Training mixes LATR groups with standard stochastic groups to reduce train–test mismatch. The paper specifies exponential decay of the LATR share, with \(\gamma=0.985\) for Countdown and \(0.995\) for math.

Verification and update. Countdown extracts the expression enclosed by the task’s answer tags, checks format, confirms that every provided number is used exactly once, executes the expression, and compares the value to the target; format-only success receives 0.1 and full correctness 1.0. Math extracts the Answer: result and uses binary exact correctness under the integer-answer protocol. These terminal scalar rewards feed group-relative GRPO or DAPO updates; no step-level label is created. Runs use VeRL 0.5.0, AdamW, constant learning rate \(10^{-6}\), global batch/minibatch size 256, and eight NVIDIA H200 GPUs. DAPO also uses group filtering and a generation batch of 384.

Released-script drift. Countdown scripts match the paper’s 0.25/0.15/0.4 thresholds, but the released math scripts set absolute 0.15 and relative 0.25, disable edit-distance pruning, and enable suffix-match 0.2 plus ROUGE-L 0.5. The scripts also encode task-specific piecewise mix_ratio_schedule dictionaries rather than the paper’s exponential schedule. A faithful reproduction must pin paper/arXiv v3, Git commit 2adb0edf24cc9a9342ac021892897adcec1a2738, HF commit 082e3b599960ef8341d1f00be8ae474d994345cf, VeRL 0.5.0, task data snapshots, reward extraction, all tree parameters, schedule, seed, and hardware—and must choose and report whether it follows the paper or the released math scripts.

Outputs and use. Runtime outputs are prompt-conditioned rollout groups with surviving completions and terminal rewards, consumed immediately by RLVR. Raw token distributions, branch parents/birth steps, lookahead segments, prune/keep decisions, rejected and completed paths, reward decisions, group membership, and policy-update records are not published. The HF files can seed the prompt/reward side of a rerun, but they cannot replay or audit the paper’s online tree generation.

输入与预处理。 Countdown 提供算术表达式训练任务和官方测试集。DAPO-Math 提供训练问题；论文人工划分出 1,024 条 validation set，MATH-500、AMC-2023 和 Olympiad-Bench 则用于外部评估。部分原始答案不是整数的数学问题，通过 few-shot Gemini-2.5-Pro 提示被改写为整数答案任务。转换输入、输出、被拒绝的改写和验证日志均未发布。公开数据由 countdown-base/train.parquet、countdown-base/test.parquet、math-base/train.parquet 和 math-base/test.parquet 组成；精确来源快照、逐文件行数、去重和重叠控制均为 unknown。

策略与分组预算。 主要实验以 Qwen2.5-3B Base 初始化，进行 500 步在线 RL。每个提示请求 \(k=8\) 个回答。论文报告的训练采样参数为 temperature 1.0、top-k \(-1\)、top-p 1.0；评估参数为 temperature 0.6、top-k 20、top-p 0.95。Countdown 的最大回答长度为 1,024 token，数学任务为 8,192 token。额外的泛化实验使用 Qwen2.5-7B 和 Qwen3-1.7B-Base。

分支。 对每条活跃序列，最高概率 token 延续父分支。非首选 token 只有在其概率超过 \(\tau_{\mathrm{abs}}\)，且与首选候选的概率差低于 \(\tau_{\mathrm{rel}}\) 时，才可在目标树宽范围内产生子分支。论文主配置报告 \(\tau_{\mathrm{abs}}=0.25\)、\(\tau_{\mathrm{rel}}=0.15\)。公开脚本还把每个 token 位置纳入考虑的分支候选上限设为两个。

前瞻与剪枝。 新出生的分支在 20、30 和 50 token 的窗口中继续模拟。论文用归一化 token-ID 编辑距离形式化父子分支差异，并报告阈值 \(\tau_{\mathrm{ed}}=0.4\)；持续过于相似的分支会连同其后代一起删除。因此，方法依据未来轨迹证据而不是单个分支 token 判断是否继续分配 rollout 预算。随机分支、取消或随机化剪枝、token-level 前瞻是论文考察的较弱替代方案。

完成与混合。 达到目标宽度或受控树阶段结束后，普通随机解码完成各序列。剪枝可能使存活分支少于八条；fill_return_sequences 可复制存活序列以满足所需分组大小，因此返回八行不等于得到八条不同路径。训练混合 LATR 组与标准随机组，以减轻 train–test mismatch。论文规定 LATR 占比按指数衰减，Countdown 的 \(\gamma=0.985\)，数学任务的 \(\gamma=0.995\)。

验证与更新。 Countdown 提取任务所规定答案标签内的表达式，检查格式、确认每个给定数字恰好使用一次、执行表达式并与目标比较；仅格式正确得 0.1，完全正确得 1.0。数学任务提取 Answer: 结果，并按整数答案协议进行二值精确正确性判断。这些终点标量奖励进入组内相对的 GRPO 或 DAPO 更新，不生成步骤级标签。实验使用 VeRL 0.5.0、AdamW、恒定学习率 \(10^{-6}\)、全局 batch/minibatch 256 和八张 NVIDIA H200；DAPO 还使用分组过滤与 384 的生成 batch。

公开脚本漂移。 Countdown 脚本与论文的 0.25/0.15/0.4 阈值一致；公开数学脚本却把绝对阈值设为 0.15、相对阈值设为 0.25，关闭编辑距离剪枝，并开启阈值 0.2 的 suffix-match 和阈值 0.5 的 ROUGE-L。脚本还使用按任务定义的分段 mix_ratio_schedule 字典，而不是论文的指数调度。严格复现必须固定论文/arXiv v3、Git commit 2adb0edf24cc9a9342ac021892897adcec1a2738、HF commit 082e3b599960ef8341d1f00be8ae474d994345cf、VeRL 0.5.0、任务数据快照、奖励提取、全部树参数、调度、随机种子和硬件；同时必须明确报告采用论文配置还是公开数学脚本配置。

输出与用途。 运行时输出是以提示为条件、包含存活回答及终点奖励的 rollout 组，并立即用于 RLVR。原始 token 分布、分支父节点与出生步、前瞻片段、保留或剪枝决定、被拒绝和已完成路径、奖励判定、分组成员关系及策略更新记录均未发布。HF 文件可提供复现实验所需的 prompt/reward 一侧，却无法重放或审计论文的在线树生成过程。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
All numerical results below are author-reported from the ICLR 2026 paper and were not independently reproduced. The primary comparison holds the policy-update algorithm fixed and replaces stochastic rollouts with LATR for 500-step Qwen2.5-3B Base runs.

Final accuracy. On Countdown with DAPO, Pass@1 rises from 70.7 for stochastic rollouts to 74.7 with LATR. On the DAPO-Math validation set with DAPO, it rises from 26.8 to 32.5. The same DAPO comparison reports 37.8 to 45.3 on AMC-2023, 60.4 to 62.6 on MATH-500, and 28.1 to 30.4 on Olympiad-Bench (Tables 1–3). Across the task–optimizer combinations summarized by the authors, the reported average final Pass@1 improvement is 4.2 percentage points. These comparisons support a claim about the training recipe under the reported model, tasks, verifier, and response budget; they do not establish quality of the processed HF rows.

Learning speed and systems cost. The paper reports 131% average learning acceleration and approximately 2.3 times fewer steps/time to reach comparable performance, while each LATR training step is about 10% slower because dynamic branch insertion, deletion, and comparison remain sequential (Sections 4.2–4.3; Appendix C.4). “131% acceleration” must not be read as 131% lower wall-clock cost. The official repository further reports about 130 GB peak GPU memory on eight H200 GPUs and warns that reducing rollout micro-batch size trades efficiency for memory.

Diversity and ablations. Table 4 reports more distinct Countdown answers per group and higher Pass@8 under LATR, linking the intervention to group diversity rather than only final Pass@1. The same table gives an important negative result: for a Qwen2.5 model trained with LATR, stochastic evaluation decoding yields Pass@1 70.9, whereas LATR evaluation decoding yields 68.9. This supports the authors’ train–test-mismatch concern and argues against treating LATR as a default inference method. Table 5 shows that random branching is unstable, no or random pruning underperforms, and token-level lookahead is weaker than trajectory-level lookahead; the benefit therefore does not follow from adding arbitrary extra branches.

Generalization and scope. Section 5.5 and Table 6 extend experiments to Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-1.7B-Base, but the verified evidence covers only arithmetic/logical Countdown and mathematical problem solving with programmatic final-answer verification. It does not demonstrate code generation, formal proof, open-ended judging, human-feedback tasks, or non-verifiable environments.

Artifact evidence. The official code implements a VeRL rollout worker, reward functions, branch/prune filters, and GRPO/DAPO scripts at inspected commit 2adb0edf24cc9a9342ac021892897adcec1a2738. The official HF repository at commit 082e3b599960ef8341d1f00be8ae474d994345cf contains four processed Parquet files totaling 24,668,606 bytes and is tagged 100K<n<1M; exact row counts per file were not stated in the checked metadata. Checked rows contain prompts and ground-truth reward metadata, not the search traces needed to reproduce the diversity or pruning analyses.

The strongest supported conclusion is conditional: under the paper’s Qwen/VeRL, task, verifier, and eight-response settings, structured trajectory-level branching and pruning can produce more useful on-policy reward groups and improve learning relative to stochastic sampling. Benchmark gains are not evidence that every branch is semantically diverse, that raw data are available, or that the recipe is reproducible without resolving configuration drift.

以下所有数字均为 ICLR 2026 论文的作者报告结果，尚未独立复现。主要比较固定策略更新算法，只在 500 步 Qwen2.5-3B Base 实验中把随机 rollout 替换为 LATR。

最终准确率。 在 Countdown 的 DAPO 实验中，Pass@1 从随机 rollout 的 70.7 提升到 LATR 的 74.7；在 DAPO-Math validation set 的 DAPO 实验中，从 26.8 提升到 32.5。同一 DAPO 比较在 AMC-2023 上报告 37.8 到 45.3，在 MATH-500 上报告 60.4 到 62.6，在 Olympiad-Bench 上报告 28.1 到 30.4（表 1–3）。作者汇总的任务—优化器组合平均最终 Pass@1 增益为 4.2 个百分点。这些比较支持的是在指定模型、任务、verifier 和回答预算下对训练配方的判断，并不证明 HF 预处理行的数据质量。

学习速度与系统成本。 论文报告平均学习加速 131%，并称达到相当性能所需的步数/时间约减少为原来的 \(1/2.3\)；但由于动态分支插入、删除和比较仍带有顺序开销，每个 LATR 训练步约慢 10%（第 4.2–4.3 节；附录 C.4）。“131% 加速”不能解释为墙钟成本降低 131%。官方仓库还报告八张 H200 上峰值显存约 130 GB，并提示降低 rollout micro-batch size 会以效率换取显存。

多样性与消融。 表 4 报告 LATR 每组产生更多不同的 Countdown 答案，并获得更高 Pass@8，把干预与组多样性联系起来，而不只与最终 Pass@1 联系起来。同一张表也提供重要负面结果：对于用 LATR 训练的 Qwen2.5 模型，随机评估解码的 Pass@1 为 70.9，LATR 评估解码反而为 68.9。这支持作者关于 train–test mismatch 的担忧，也不支持把 LATR 当作默认推理方式。表 5 显示随机分支不稳定，取消或随机化剪枝表现较差，token-level 前瞻也弱于 trajectory-level 前瞻；收益并不是任意增加分支就能得到的。

泛化与范围。 第 5.5 节和表 6 把实验扩展到 Qwen2.5-7B 与 Qwen3-1.7B-Base，但已核验证据只覆盖由程序化最终答案验证的算术/逻辑 Countdown 和数学解题。论文没有证明对代码生成、形式化证明、开放式 judge、人类反馈任务或不可验证环境的迁移。

Artifact 证据。 官方代码在已检查的 commit 2adb0edf24cc9a9342ac021892897adcec1a2738 上实现了 VeRL rollout worker、奖励函数、分支/剪枝过滤器和 GRPO/DAPO 脚本。官方 HF 仓库在 commit 082e3b599960ef8341d1f00be8ae474d994345cf 上包含四个预处理 Parquet 文件，总计 24,668,606 字节，标签为 100K<n<1M；已检查元数据未给出逐文件精确行数。抽查行包含提示与 ground-truth 奖励元数据，不含复现多样性或剪枝分析所需的搜索轨迹。

最强的有证据结论仍是条件性的：在论文的 Qwen/VeRL、任务、verifier 和八回答设置下，结构化的轨迹级分支与剪枝可以产生更有用的在线奖励分组，并相对随机采样改善学习。benchmark 增益不能证明每个分支在语义上都不同，不能证明原始数据已发布，也不能证明在未解决配置漂移时可以精确复现配方。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline in this paper is token-level stochastic sampling for group-based RLVR. Sampling different next tokens does not guarantee different trajectories because branches can reconverge into nearly identical continuations. Other tree-search methods often use search to choose an inference answer or derive step/process values. LATR instead changes the online rollout worker while retaining the terminal programmatic reward and GRPO/DAPO update.

What changes is the selection interface for a fixed response-count group. Candidate tokens must pass probability gates; a branch then has to survive trajectory-level lookahead and similarity pruning before it consumes the remaining completion budget. This makes branch birth, simulated continuation, prune/keep decision, surviving full response, and terminal reward the natural audit object. The public release stops before that interface: it provides processed task and reward inputs, not a serialized tree.

The individual components—token probabilities, branching, edit distance, stochastic completion, terminal verification, and group-relative RL—are not new in isolation. The paper-specific contribution is their integration into a hybrid online rollout recipe whose explicit aim is to prevent local sampling differences from collapsing back into the same reasoning path. Its ablations matter because arbitrary random branching, missing/random pruning, and token-level lookahead do not reproduce the same result.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is concrete: group composition can change the variance and usefulness of verifiable rewards even when prompt source, optimizer, terminal checker, nominal number of responses, and base policy are held fixed. This separates “how many rollouts” from “which trajectories occupy the rollout budget.” It also creates a new attribution requirement: gains can come from search topology and rejection policy rather than from a new corpus, verifier, or objective.

Before reuse, compare stochastic and LATR groups at matched generated tokens and wall-clock cost, report unique-path counts rather than only returned-row counts, audit semantic rather than lexical diversity, and retain pruned/rejected branches. The novelty claim should not be expanded into claims of new step supervision, a learned verifier, test-time compute scaling, or a released trajectory dataset.

论文中的既有基线是用于分组式 RLVR 的 token-level 随机采样。采到不同的 next token 并不保证得到不同轨迹，因为分支可能重新收敛到几乎相同的后续内容。其他树搜索方法常把搜索用于推理答案选择，或从树中推导步骤/过程价值。LATR 则替换在线 rollout worker，同时保留终点程序化奖励与 GRPO/DAPO 更新。

真正改变的是固定回答数分组的选择接口。候选 token 先要通过概率门控；随后分支必须经过轨迹级前瞻和相似度剪枝，才会继续消耗剩余回答预算。因此，分支出生、模拟后续、保留或剪枝决定、存活的完整回答和终点奖励共同构成自然的审计对象。公开发布在这个接口之前停止：它提供预处理后的任务与奖励输入，而不是序列化搜索树。

token 概率、分支、编辑距离、随机完成、终点验证和组内相对 RL 这些组件单独看都不是新概念。论文特有的贡献，是把它们整合为一种混合在线 rollout 配方，明确用于阻止局部采样差异重新坍缩到同一推理路径。消融实验因而重要：任意随机分支、缺失或随机剪枝、token-level 前瞻都不能复现完整方法的结果。

对推理数据研究而言，方向信号很具体：即使提示来源、优化器、终点检查器、名义回答数和基础策略保持不变，组内成员的构成方式仍会改变可验证奖励的方差与训练效用。这把“有多少条 rollout”和“哪些轨迹占用 rollout 预算”区分开来，也提出新的归因要求：性能收益可能来自搜索拓扑与拒绝策略，而不是新语料、verifier 或目标函数。

复用前应在生成 token 与墙钟成本匹配的条件下比较随机组和 LATR 组，报告不同路径数而不是只报告返回行数，审计语义多样性而不只审计词面差异，并保留被剪枝/拒绝的分支。不能把其新意扩大为新的步骤监督、学习式 verifier、测试时计算扩展或已发布的轨迹数据集。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Verifier and modeling limits. Both rewards judge terminal answers. Countdown’s checker can validate format, number use, execution, and target equality; the math checker compares an extracted final answer. Neither verifies intermediate reasoning. A correct final answer can reward a flawed or unfaithful path, while extraction or normalization failures can reject a substantively correct response. The Gemini-2.5-Pro integer-answer rewriting adds an upstream model-dependent transformation whose full prompt, item-level outputs, failures, and validation decisions are not released.

Diversity proxy and tree behavior. Normalized token edit distance, suffix match, and ROUGE-L are lexical proxies. They can preserve superficially different but semantically equivalent trajectories or prune semantically different paths with similar wording. Probability gating can admit low-probability branches that increase KL or exhaust the width budget early. If pruning leaves fewer than eight branches, padding can duplicate a survivor; treating group size as unique-trajectory count would be an audit error. These are curator analyses grounded in the disclosed data object, not independent measurements of the released runs.

Missing online data. The paper’s central object is generated during RL, but the official HF release contains processed prompts and reward metadata. It omits generated completions, token probabilities, parent and birth metadata, lookahead segments, prune/keep decisions, completed and rejected branches, per-trajectory rewards, update-group membership, and checkpoint lineage. Without those records, readers cannot replay branch selection, test alternative diversity metrics, measure false pruning, or reconstruct the exact groups behind an update.

Configuration and version drift. The paper’s main setup uses absolute/relative/edit-distance thresholds 0.25/0.15/0.4, windows 20/30/50, and exponential LATR-share decay. Released Countdown scripts are aligned on the thresholds, but math scripts use 0.15/0.25, disable edit distance, add suffix 0.2 and ROUGE-L 0.5, and use piecewise mixing schedules. The repository describes its schedule dictionary as more flexible, but does not identify which script/config produced every reported table. Exact paper reproduction is blocked until this discrepancy is reconciled.

Selection, split, and contamination. The release has Countdown and math train/test Parquet files, while the paper describes a manually partitioned 1,024-item DAPO-Math validation set and separate external benchmarks. Exact per-file counts, source revisions, selection manifests, transformation yields, duplicate rules, and record-level provenance are unknown. No decontamination or benchmark-overlap procedure was found. Because public math corpora and benchmarks are reused across the ecosystem, the reported benchmark deltas cannot resolve contamination risk.

Systems and generalization. LATR is reported about 10% slower per step and roughly 130 GB peak memory on eight H200s; dynamic sequence insertion/removal and comparison lack tree-specific batching kernels. The claim of fewer steps to a target score does not remove hardware, memory, or engineering costs. Experiments cover verifiable arithmetic and mathematics; transfer to code, proofs, agents, open-ended tasks, different verifiers, or larger frontier policies remains unknown. The Table 4 result—68.9 Pass@1 with LATR decoding versus 70.9 with stochastic decoding for a LATR-trained model—also shows that training-time diversity does not automatically justify inference-time LATR.

Licensing and release governance. The arXiv PDF uses the arXiv non-exclusive distribution license, which does not license code or data. No code license was found in the pinned Git tree, and the HF card/API exposes no dataset license or license file. Upstream Countdown and DAPO-Math derivative-data rights also require review. Public visibility therefore is not sufficient evidence for redistribution, commercial training, or derivative release.

The status remains partial. Strong paper and artifact verification coexist with missing raw trees, absent failure retention, unresolved paper–script drift, unknown decontamination, unknown code/data rights, undisclosed transformation logs, and no independent reproduction.

Verifier 与建模限制。 两类奖励都只判断终点答案。Countdown 检查器能够验证格式、数字使用、表达式执行和目标相等；数学检查器比较提取出的最终答案。二者都不验证中间推理。错误或不忠实的路径可能因最终答案正确而得到奖励，实质正确的回答也可能因提取或归一化失败被拒绝。Gemini-2.5-Pro 的整数答案改写还引入了依赖外部模型的上游转换，但完整提示、逐条输出、失败样本和验证决定均未发布。

多样性代理与树行为。 归一化 token 编辑距离、suffix match 和 ROUGE-L 都是词面代理。它们可能保留表面不同但语义等价的轨迹，也可能剪掉用词相似但语义不同的路径。概率门控可能接纳低概率分支，增大 KL 或过早耗尽宽度预算。如果剪枝后不足八条，补齐逻辑可以复制存活分支；把分组大小当作不同轨迹数量属于审计错误。这些是基于已披露数据对象的 curator 分析，不是对公开实验运行的独立测量。

在线数据缺失。 论文核心对象在 RL 过程中生成，但官方 HF 发布只有预处理提示与奖励元数据。它不包含生成结果、token 概率、父分支与出生元数据、前瞻片段、保留/剪枝决定、完成和被拒绝的分支、逐轨迹奖励、更新组成员关系或 checkpoint 谱系。缺少这些记录时，读者无法重放分支选择、测试其他多样性指标、测量错误剪枝，也无法重建一次更新背后的精确分组。

配置与版本漂移。 论文主配置使用 0.25/0.15/0.4 的绝对/相对/编辑距离阈值、20/30/50 的窗口和 LATR 占比指数衰减。公开 Countdown 脚本的阈值与论文一致；数学脚本却使用 0.15/0.25，关闭编辑距离，增加 0.2 的 suffix 与 0.5 的 ROUGE-L，并使用分段混合调度。仓库把调度字典描述为更灵活，但没有说明每张报告表格对应哪份脚本/配置。该差异在得到解释前会阻碍论文配置的精确复现。

选择、切分与污染。 发布物包含 Countdown 与 math 的 train/test Parquet 文件；论文则描述人工划分的 1,024 条 DAPO-Math validation set 和独立外部 benchmark。逐文件精确行数、来源版本、选择清单、转换产出、重复规则和记录级 provenance 均为 unknown。已检查材料中没有去污染或 benchmark 重叠流程。公共数学语料和 benchmark 在生态中被广泛复用，因此论文分数差异本身不能排除污染风险。

系统与泛化。 论文报告 LATR 每步约慢 10%，八张 H200 的峰值显存约 130 GB；动态序列插入/删除和比较缺少树结构专用批处理 kernel。达到目标分数所需步数减少，并不消除硬件、显存和工程成本。实验覆盖可验证的算术与数学；对代码、证明、agent、开放式任务、不同 verifier 或更大前沿策略的迁移均为 unknown。表 4 中 LATR 训练模型用 LATR 解码得到 68.9 Pass@1、用随机解码得到 70.9，也说明训练时多样性不能自动为推理时使用 LATR 辩护。

许可证与发布治理。 arXiv PDF 使用 arXiv non-exclusive distribution license，该许可不覆盖代码或数据。固定版本 Git tree 中未发现代码许可证，HF card/API 也没有数据许可证字段或 license 文件。Countdown 和 DAPO-Math 的上游衍生数据权利还需审查。因此，公开可见不能作为再分发、商业训练或衍生发布的充分授权证据。

条目状态仍为 partial。论文和 artifact 已得到较强核验，但原始树缺失、失败样本未保留、论文—脚本漂移未解决、去污染未知、代码/数据权利未知、转换日志未披露，且结果尚未独立复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, LATR is a concrete recipe for separating rollout count from rollout topology. A follow-up study can hold the prompt pool, policy, terminal reward, optimizer, and nominal \(k=8\) group size fixed, then vary probability gates, lookahead length, similarity metric, pruning policy, hybrid schedule, and failure retention. This makes search-generated group composition an experimentally controllable data variable.

Practical uses include:

  • implementing a branch–lookahead–prune rollout worker for GRPO or DAPO and comparing it with stochastic sampling at matched response, generated-token, and wall-clock budgets;
  • recording raw parent/birth links, lookahead segments, prune reasons, terminal rewards, and group membership to build an auditable search-trace dataset that the official release does not provide;
  • testing whether edit distance, suffix match, or ROUGE-L predicts semantic trajectory diversity, including false-prune and false-retain audits;
  • measuring how duplicate padding, all-same-reward groups, low-probability branches, and the LATR/stochastic mixing schedule affect policy gradients;
  • using the paper–script discrepancy as a reproducibility case study in configuration lineage and version-pinned recipe reporting.

The appropriate reuse class is strong recipe/audit reference; conditional evaluation and reproduction; training-data reuse blocked pending rights and lineage checks. The public Parquet rows can provide processed task and reward inputs for a research rerun, but they are not reusable LATR trajectories. Code and data licenses are unknown, exact source snapshots and decontamination are missing, and the math scripts do not unambiguously implement the paper’s main configuration. Redistribution or production training should wait for explicit licenses and upstream-rights review.

Evaluation reuse should preserve the separation among the 1,024-item DAPO-Math validation partition, MATH-500, AMC-2023, Olympiad-Bench, and any adapted training pool. Report response count, unique surviving trajectories, generated tokens, branch attempts, pruned/rejected branches, per-step latency, peak memory, and final wall-clock budget separately. Pass@1 improvement alone cannot attribute gains to better data rather than extra sequential work or selection effects.

The Card is also useful as a release checklist: processed prompts are not enough to audit a search-data paper. A reusable release needs serialized trees, all failures, verifier decisions, immutable source and transformation manifests, paper-matching configurations, and explicit licenses.

对于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，LATR 提供了一种把 rollout 数量与 rollout 拓扑分开的具体配方。后续研究可以固定提示池、策略、终点奖励、优化器和名义 \(k=8\) 分组大小，再分别改变概率门控、前瞻长度、相似度指标、剪枝策略、混合调度和失败保留方式，从而把搜索生成的组构成变成可控的数据变量。

具体用途包括：

  • 为 GRPO 或 DAPO 实现“分支—前瞻—剪枝”rollout worker，并在回答数、生成 token 和墙钟预算匹配时与随机采样比较；
  • 记录原始父分支/出生链接、前瞻片段、剪枝原因、终点奖励和分组成员关系，建立官方发布未提供的可审计搜索轨迹数据集；
  • 检验编辑距离、suffix match 或 ROUGE-L 能否预测语义轨迹多样性，包括错误剪枝与错误保留审计；
  • 测量重复补齐、全同奖励组、低概率分支和 LATR/随机混合调度对策略梯度的影响；
  • 把论文—脚本差异作为配置谱系与固定版本配方报告的复现案例。

适当的复用等级是：强配方/审计参考；有条件的评估与复现；训练数据复用在权利和谱系核验完成前受阻。公开 Parquet 行可以为研究性复现提供预处理任务和奖励输入，但它们不是可复用的 LATR 轨迹。代码和数据许可证未知，精确来源快照和去污染缺失，数学脚本也没有无歧义地实现论文主配置。再分发或生产训练应等待明确许可证和上游权利审查。

评估复用必须保持 1,024 条 DAPO-Math validation partition、MATH-500、AMC-2023、Olympiad-Bench 与任何改造后训练池之间的分离。应分别报告回答数、不同存活轨迹数、生成 token、分支尝试数、被剪枝/拒绝分支数、每步延迟、峰值显存和最终墙钟预算。Pass@1 提升本身无法把收益归因于更好的数据，而不是额外顺序计算或选择效应。

本 Card 还可作为发布清单：预处理提示不足以审计搜索数据论文。可复用发布需要序列化树、全部失败样本、verifier 决定、不可变的来源与转换清单、与论文匹配的配置，以及明确许可证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.1–3.3 and Algorithm 1 as one contract: probability-gated branch birth, trajectory-level lookahead/pruning, stochastic completion, and hybrid mixing jointly define the online data object.
  • Keep the two artifacts separate: the runtime object is a width-eight rollout tree/group with branch and reward decisions; the HF release is four processed prompt/reward Parquet files and contains no raw trees or rejected/pruned paths.
  • For results, pair Tables 1–3 with Tables 4–5 and Appendix C.4: the score gains coexist with about 10% slower steps, a 70.9-versus-68.9 stochastic/LATR decoding reversal, and ablations showing that arbitrary branches are insufficient.
  • Before reproduction, reconcile paper thresholds and exponential mixing with the released math scripts’ 0.15/0.25 gates, suffix/ROUGE pruning, and piecewise schedule; pin both the Git and HF commits.
  • Before reuse, require exact row/source manifests, Gemini rewrite logs, serialized branch/reward records, decontamination evidence, and explicit code/data licenses; benchmark performance is not a substitute for these audits.

• 应把第 3.1–3.3 节与算法 1 连起来阅读：概率门控的分支出生、轨迹级前瞻/剪枝、随机完成和混合调度共同定义在线数据对象。
  • 必须区分两类 artifact：运行时对象是带有分支和奖励决定的宽度八 rollout 树/组；HF 发布则是四个预处理 prompt/reward Parquet 文件，不含原始树或被拒绝/剪枝路径。
  • 阅读结果时应把表 1–3 与表 4–5、附录 C.4 配对：分数增益同时伴随每步约慢 10%、随机/LATR 解码 70.9 对 68.9 的反转，以及“任意增加分支并不足够”的消融结果。
  • 复现前必须协调论文阈值与指数混合，同公开数学脚本的 0.15/0.25 门控、suffix/ROUGE 剪枝和分段调度之间的差异，并同时固定 Git 与 HF commit。
  • 复用前应要求精确行数/来源清单、Gemini 改写日志、序列化分支与奖励记录、去污染证据及明确代码/数据许可证；benchmark 表现不能替代这些审计。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Official conference citation:

value.html: Countdown training/test tasks and DAPO-Math training plus a manually partitioned 1,024-item validation set; MATH-500, AMC-2023, and Olympiad-Bench are external evaluation sets. The official processed release has countdown-base and math-base train/test Parquet files, but exact source revisions, selection manifests, and released per-file row counts are unknown.

Online samples are full reasoning completions ending in a task-specific final answer: Countdown uses an expression in <answer> tags, while math uses an Answer: line. The public HF artifact contains processed prompt/reward rows rather than generated completions or tree trajectories.

The current on-policy model generates LATR and stochastic trajectories during RL. Main experiments use Qwen2.5-3B Base; Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-1.7B-Base appear in generalization experiments. Gemini-2.5-Pro rewrites non-integer-answer math questions upstream but is not the online rollout policy or reward.

A VeRL-0.5.0 online RL rollout worker builds a width-bounded dynamic tree, branches at probability-qualified token alternatives, simulates continuations, prunes branches that remain too similar to their parents, then falls back to stochastic generation. The released HF rows supply prompts and reward metadata; they do not preserve the runtime tree.

Countdown uses 0.1 times format validity plus 0.9 times executable correctness, requiring every supplied number exactly once and the target value. Math uses a binary terminal correctness reward after answer normalization to integer-valued tasks. Rewards are compared within GRPO or DAPO groups; there are no step labels or learned process rewards.

Countdown succeeds when the extracted expression is valid, uses exactly the supplied numbers, and evaluates to the target. Math succeeds when the extracted final answer exactly matches the transformed integer reference under the paper's evaluation protocol.
Qwen2.5-3B Base for the main 500-step experiments; Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-1.7B-Base are additional generalization-study models.
Gemini-2.5-Pro is used with a few-shot prompt to rewrite math questions whose original answers are non-integers into integer-answer tasks. No teacher model generates the online LATR trajectories.

Current-policy LATR: extend each active branch with its top token, branch to non-top tokens that pass absolute and relative probability thresholds, simulate fixed lookahead windows, remove insufficiently divergent branches and descendants, then complete surviving branches with stochastic sampling.

Eight rollouts per prompt. The paper reports training temperature 1.0, top-k -1, top-p 1.0 and evaluation temperature 0.6, top-k 20, top-p 0.95. Hybrid training reduces the LATR share toward stochastic sampling; the paper specifies exponential decay, while released scripts use task-specific piecewise schedules.
1.0 for training rollouts; 0.6 for evaluation

Paper-side main settings use absolute probability threshold 0.25, relative gap threshold 0.15, normalized edit-distance threshold 0.4, and windows 20, 30, and 50. Released Countdown scripts match these thresholds; released Math scripts instead use absolute 0.15, relative 0.25, disable edit-distance pruning, and enable suffix-match 0.2 plus ROUGE-L 0.5, so the paper-matching Math rule is unresolved.

Maximum completion length is 1,024 tokens for Countdown and 8,192 for math; tree width is bounded by eight rollouts and released scripts consider at most two branching candidates per token. Raw token, branch, and pruning budgets are not released per record.

GRPO or DAPO in VeRL 0.5.0 for 500 steps with AdamW, constant learning rate 1e-6, global batch/minibatch size 256, and eight NVIDIA H200 GPUs. DAPO uses group filtering and an oversampled generation batch of 384.

Countdown and DAPO-Math provide RL prompts; MATH-500, AMC-2023, and Olympiad-Bench are external evaluations. HF publishes four processed Parquet files totaling 24,668,606 bytes and labels the release 100K<n<1M, but exact row counts, source revisions, mixture manifests, and transformation yields are unknown.

Countdown uses a training split and official test split. DAPO-Math uses training data and a manually partitioned 1,024-sample validation set. HF exposes train and test files for both countdown-base and math-base; exact correspondence to the paper partitions is not fully documented.

items: The public HF artifact is processed prompt/reward data, not the raw high-diversity rollout trees suggested by the dataset-card prose.
Paper and released Math scripts disagree on probability thresholds, similarity metrics, and hybrid-mixing schedules, blocking exact paper-configuration reproduction.
If pruning leaves fewer than eight branches, implementation padding can duplicate a surviving sequence; a nominal group of eight is not necessarily eight distinct trajectories.
Token edit-distance, suffix, or ROUGE similarity can mistake superficial lexical divergence for a different reasoning strategy, or prune semantically distinct paths with similar token sequences.
Explicit diversity optimization creates a train-test mismatch; the paper's own Table 4 shows lower Pass@1 for a trained LATR model when decoded with LATR rather than stochastic sampling.
Random or overly permissive branching can select low-probability trajectories, increase off-policy KL, destabilize training, and exhaust the fixed rollout budget early.
LATR is reported about 10% slower per step, uses approximately 130 GB peak memory on eight H200 GPUs, and lacks tree-specific batching optimizations.
Exact released row counts, source snapshots, transformation logs, decontamination, code/data licenses, and raw rollout/reward artifacts are absent.

value.html: The arXiv paper carries the arXiv non-exclusive distribution license. The pinned GitHub tree has no LICENSE/COPYING file or license declaration, and the HF dataset card/API has no dataset license field or license file. Code, processed rows, and upstream derivative-data reuse terms are therefore unknown.

Countdown/DAPO-Math source tasks, with Gemini-2.5-Pro rewriting for some math answers, become processed prompt/reward rows; the current policy then generates hybrid LATR/stochastic rollout groups, programmatic terminal verifiers score them, and GRPO or DAPO performs group-relative updates. Record-level source revisions, transformation logs, raw branches, pruned/rejected paths, reward decisions, group membership, and checkpoint lineage are not released.
